method: Unchanged original block registry objects 125/126 (BlockWoodSlab double/single), 96 (BlockTrapDoor), 107 (BlockFenceGate), 139 (BlockWall) and 85 (BlockFence) over a map-backed World double (an ahb subclass) that dispatches the original neighbour notifications in World order (breakBlock, onBlockAdded, then x-1, x+1, y-1, y+1, z-1, z+1 for flag 1), records writes, aux effects, sounds and real EntityItem drops, and reads redstone as an explicit set of powered cells for isBlockIndirectlyGettingPowered. ItemSlab, ItemBlock and ItemMultiTexture run through onItemUse with an Unsafe-allocated EntityPlayerMP; no render engine or tick loop is instantiated. Collision boxes come from addCollisionBoxesToList, selection from getSelectedBoundingBoxFromPool and ray traces from collisionRayTrace.
